why: Image 1 reads as a specific, lived-in room: layered warm light from pendants, table globes and under-bar strips, plausible wood, concrete and leather, and a deep editorial perspective, though the cloned stools and the daylight-like hard patches on the wall at night give it away as CG on close inspection. Image 2 is two-thirds black frame around a stage-set vignette whose glowing red translucent speakers and floating neon sphere look like rendered props rather than objects in a real room, so it would not pass as a photograph.
